title: fix(plugin-auth)!: the settings save keeps a way to sign in under the local sign-in path off, and a blocked client lands on the sign-in page from the direct sign-in door
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb8CDLT8YAjNiG4Z8mgQQdT9)_

Fixes #33358

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — narrowed: with direct sign-in on and its local sign-in path `off`, an auth settings save (`PUT /api/settings/auth`) that turns Google off, or clears a Google client credential no environment variable backs, while Google is the last way in the sign-in page offers answers `400 SETTINGS_VALIDATION` (copy `googleLocalOff`) and saves nothing, where it saved, even with email and password or phone sign-in on; and a `GET /api/v1/auth/sign-in/direct` from a client the IP allow-list refuses answers `302` to `/login?error=IP_NOT_ALLOWED`, where it answered the `403 IP_NOT_ALLOWED` JSON body. Widened: under `off` with nothing else in force (no Google, no identity provider row, no social or OIDC provider with credentials, no host sign-in handoff), a save of `email_password_enabled: false` answers `200` and saves, where it answered `400 SETTINGS_VALIDATION`, because the sign-in page offers no email and password there either way; module exports (not on the package entry) `DIRECT_SIGN_IN_NETWORK_REFUSED`, `isDirectSignInDoorNavigation` and `directSignInNetworkRefusal`; the copy key `googleLocalOff` in all 11 locales; the `@object-ui/i18n` key `auth.login.errors.networkNotAllowed` in all 11 packs (no key renamed or removed); `markSignOutRoundTrip` takes the sign-in page path it records.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` teaches direct sign-in, the auth settings save, the IP allow-list or the sign-out note; `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` gains the rules in this change.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：直接登录把本地登录路径设为 off 后，保存认证设置时不再把邮箱/密码当作还能登录的方式，删掉最后一个 Google 会被拒绝并给出专门的提示；被 IP 白名单拦下的浏览器打开直接登录入口时，跳回登录页并说明"不允许从你的网络登录"，不再看到原始的 403 JSON；从身份提供方注销的标记只在提供方把浏览器送回登录页那一次生效。
- 为什么改：自托管系统开了 OS_AUTH_DIRECT_SIGN_IN_LOCAL_PATH=off 时，管理员关掉最后一个 Google 登录仍能保存成功，随后所有人（包括管理员）都进不了系统；被 IP 白名单拦下的人看到一段看不懂的 JSON；提供方不回跳时，下一次打开深链接会丢掉 ?redirect=。
- 风险与回滚：**BREAKING**（声明 Clause-② narrowing）：直接登录且本地登录路径为 off 时，把 Google 作为最后一种登录方式关掉的设置保存从 200 变为 400；被 IP 白名单拦下的浏览器 GET 直接登录入口从 403 JSON 变为 302 跳回 /login?error=IP_NOT_ALLOWED。hidden 和直接登录关闭时行为不变；IP 白名单没有放宽，被拦的客户端仍然无法发起登录，POST 和带尾斜杠的路径仍是 403。回滚即撤回本 PR。
- 先看：packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sign-in-method-floor.ts 的 signInMethodFloorPredicate；auth-plugin.ts 中 IP 白名单中间件新增的一段；ui/packages/auth/src/signOutRoundTrip.ts 的 readSignOutRoundTrip。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/plugins/plugin-auth && pnpm exec vitest run src/sign-in-method-floor.test.ts src/direct-sign-in.test.ts`，预期全部通过，其中新加的 off 场景用例与 IP 白名单用例都在列。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Item 1, the settings-save half (N7).** `signInMethodFloorPredicate` now judges by what the sign-in page offers, through the same `pageOffersLocalSignIn` the provider delete and the boot report use since #33623. Under `directSignIn.localSignIn: 'off'`:

- the `google_*` change that removes the last way in (Google off, or a client credential cleared that no env variable backs) is refused `400 SETTINGS_VALIDATION` at its key with email and password ON, in a new `googleLocalOff` copy in all eleven languages of the existing table (the email-off copy's remedy, keep email and password on, does nothing there); turning email and password on in the same save does not help;
- the `email_password_enabled` key itself is never refused under `off`, because the page draws it neither way, so the save removes nothing the page offers. With nothing else in force this widens an answer: `email_password_enabled: false` was `400` on main and is now `200` (declared under Widened). Recovery after such a save needs `OS_AUTH_EMAIL_PASSWORD_ENABLED=true` as well as `OS_AUTH_DIRECT_SIGN_IN_LOCAL_PATH=hidden`, then a restart;
- phone sign-in counts only as the page offers it (`asThePageOffers: true`), as on the other two doors.

Under `hidden`, or with direct sign-in off, every answer is as on main (the `localOffered` leg is true there).

Copy nit folded in: `enterpriseSsoUnverified` (the `503` on a provider delete whose provider list could not be read) said "with email and password off"; it now says the sign-in page offers no email and password, which is true under both reasons the check runs. All eleven languages.

`content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` no longer says the settings save is still open, and names the three checks and the exits that still count.

**Item 2 (N8), the direct sign-in door under the IP allow-list.** The allow-list middleware in `auth-plugin.ts` (one hunk, disjoint from #33268's) still refuses, audits and logs exactly as before. For a GET of the mounted door only, its answer is now `302` to the Console's `/login?error=IP_NOT_ALLOWED` with the page's `?redirect=` carried (`directSignInNetworkRefusal` in `direct-sign-in.ts`, reusing `carriedRedirect` / `keptReturnPath`), instead of the raw `403` JSON. No exemption: the request never reaches the door, nothing is started, no provider is read, and every other auth request from that client (`/get-session`, `/sign-in/social`, a POST to the door path, the door path with a trailing slash) is still `403 IP_NOT_ALLOWED`. With direct sign-in off the path is not mounted and the answer is the `403` as before. The page holds on any `error` already; `ssoCallbackRefusal.ts` gains `IP_NOT_ALLOWED` with the new `@object-ui/i18n` key `auth.login.errors.networkNotAllowed` in all eleven packs (zh-Hant generated by `gen:zh-hant`), so the page says the system does not allow sign-in from this network instead of the generic "link expired" sentence. The route ledger note for `GET /api/v1/auth/sign-in/direct` says so.

**Item 3, review nit N6.** Pins for the exits under `off`: another provider row, a social provider and an OIDC provider with credentials, a host sign-in handoff, on the provider delete, the boot report and the settings save.

**Item 5 (N13).** The provider-logout note in `sessionStorage` now holds the time AND the return path (`createAuthClient.signOut` passes `resolveSpaRoute('/login')`, the sign-out's own `callbackURL`), and `readSignOutRoundTrip` honours it only on a load of that path within the window. `AuthProvider` still drops the note on every mount, so a tab whose provider never sent it back drops it unread on the next load of any other page: `LoginRedirect` then keeps the deep link's `?redirect=`. `LoginRedirect` itself is unchanged. A note in the old bare-number shape reads as no note.

## Why

An administrator of a self-hosted system with `OS_AUTH_DIRECT_SIGN_IN_LOCAL_PATH=off` could save Google off while it was the last way in, and the page then said "No sign-in method is available" to everyone. A blocked client following the direct sign-in redirect saw a raw JSON body. A provider that never returned the browser made the next deep link in the tab land on the home page.

## Verification

Final head `e25b4e31`. Round 3 (delta review 6894048463) added `e25b4e31`, a changeset-prose-only commit declaring the email-off save under `off` as widened; the changeset gates (no-major, empty-changeset, adr-0087 registration, issue citations, closed-ceremony text, changeset gate self-tests) re-ran exit 0 there. Before that, the review round (review-a FAIL 6893256448) added commit `7c6c999c` on top of `10180db4`: the changeset re-declared as narrowing, the no-Google email-key pins, the trailing-slash case and the docs sentence. Touched suites, ablations, delta gates and the dogfood battery ran on `7c6c999c` after rebuilding the closure; the full suites and the 110-family gate run are from `f76f5856` / `10180db4` (round 1), and no source file changed since, only tests, docs and the changeset.

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- Round 2 at `7c6c999c`: `sign-in-method-floor.test.ts` + `direct-sign-in.test.ts`: 2 files, 168 passed.
- Round 1: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test` under the verify lock: Test Files 277 passed (277), Tests 5481 passed, 10 skipped. After the merge of main (`spec check:generated` all 14 up to date): 5 touched files, 210 tests passed.
- Round 1 ui under the lock: `packages/i18n/`, `apps/console/src/pages/auth/`, `apps/console/src/components/__tests__`, `product-neutral-renderer.ratchet`: 137 files, 2259 passed, 13 skipped. `packages/auth` sign-out tests: 2 files, 22 passed. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 171 files passed, 2 skipped.
- Type checks (round 1): `@objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck`; turbo `type-check` for `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/i18n` (6 tasks) and `@object-ui/console` (75 tasks), all successful.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs: anchor 1 to 0 on disk, red, restored, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

Round 2, at `7c6c999c`:

- `if (!localOffered && key === 'email_password_enabled') return undefined;` → `if (false) …`: 2 red, both the new pins where nothing else is in force (the composed `under the local sign-in path off, the email and password key is never refused, even with no other way in configured`, and the off judge's no-Google case). With Google still in force the old pins stayed green, which was the review's point.
- `method.toUpperCase() === 'GET' &&` → `true &&` in `isDirectSignInDoorNavigation`: 1 red, the `POST` to the door answers 302 instead of 403.
- the path equality → `path.startsWith(basePath)`: 1 red, `/api/v1/auth/get-session` answers 302 instead of 403.
- the path equality → equality after stripping a trailing slash: 1 red, `GET /api/v1/auth/sign-in/direct/` answers 302 instead of 403 (the new trailing-slash case).
- `this.directSignInDoorMounted &&` → `true &&` in the allow-list middleware: 1 red, the CONTROL with direct sign-in off answers 302 instead of the 403 body.

Round 1, at `f76f5856`:

- `localOffered` forced true: 2 floor tests red (the composed off save and the off judge).
- off copy replaced by the email-off copy: the same 2 red.
- phone counted on the save under off (`asThePageOffers: false`): 1 red (the off judge).
- the allow-list landing branch disabled: 1 red (the blocked navigation case).
- the carried redirect dropped from the landing: 1 red.
- the `IP_NOT_ALLOWED` map entry renamed in `ssoCallbackRefusal.ts`: 1 red (the page sentence pin).
- the return-path comparison in `readSignOutRoundTrip` forced true: 3 red.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- Round 2 at `7c6c999c`: the 48 families of the round-1 list that read the changeset, docs, ADR registration, citations, comments, error codes, the auth mount ledger or skills examples, re-run: 48 exit 0 (`check:skill-examples` after building `@objectstack/client-react`, its declared prereq).
- Round 1: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 110 families; 109 exit 0; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (needs every package built) NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI. `pnpm lint` exit 0.
- Dogfood battery (owed by `!` and the narrowing arm): PASS at `7c6c999c`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock, Test Files 467 passed, 3 skipped (470); Tests 3958 passed, 42 skipped (4000); VERDICT command-exit 0 (held 33m41s, shared box).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- What to do after an email-off save under `off`: setting the local path back to `hidden` is not enough; set `OS_AUTH_EMAIL_PASSWORD_ENABLED=true` as well, then restart. `sso.mdx`'s recovery sentence already says so.
- Declared `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` per claim amendment 6893265267: two answers move (the settings save under `off` from 200 to 400, the blocked door GET from 403 to 302), so the title carries `!` and the changeset a **BREAKING** paragraph, an Unchanged paragraph, What to do, and the `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker (no schema key, value or metadata type moves, nothing stored to rewrite). The bump stays `patch`, as #33623 did.
- `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` gains the 302 sentence in the direct sign-in "No loops" list. `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` (the allow-list field row) is outside the claim surface and untouched; the sso.mdx sentence links to it.
- `AuthProvider.tsx` keeps its comment that the first mount after the round trip starts raised; that is still true of the return load, so it is untouched.
